messages:
Hannah J.: quick bring-up note: tested ember13b-int6 on conversational-prod slice (~8k sessions). posting microbench + rough product recs.

Marco F.: please paste numbers

Hannah J.: ```
model: ember13b-int6
slice: convo_prod_sample (~8k)
avg tokens/req: 95
latency p95: 190ms
latency p99: 650ms
qps/shard: 22
cost / 1M tokens: $10.8
baseline (ember13b-int8): $15.2 (~29% savings)
quality vs int8:
  - turn-helpfulness: 84.0 -> 82.1 (-1.9)
  - instruction-F1: 89.5 -> 88.2 (-1.3)
  - halluc_rate heuristic: 3.4% -> 4.8% (+1.4pp)
notes: short chit-chat fine; multi-step reasoning drops more.
```

Ellen W.: product: ~1.9pt helpfulness drop maps to ~1% session retention delta on high-value cohort. need safety routing + short canary.

Marco F.: infra thoughts: p99 650ms okay if we isolate low-latency pool. propose mixed routing: int6 bulk, int8 safety. set shadowing to estimate divergence.

Hannah J.: proposed rollout:
- 10% canary for 7d with event tags (helpfulness, halluc markers)
- mixed fleet after pass: 70% int6 /30% int8; safety classifier promotes queries to int8
- auto-fallback: helpfulness drop >1.2pt or halluc +1.0pp sustained 36h -> rollback

infra-bot: Canary scheduled: ember13b-int6 -> convo route 10% starting 2025-05-28T12:00:00Z (owner: Hannah J.).

Marco F.: action items: Hannah push eval config + safety classifier proto; I'll wire routing flags and shadowing. Ellen signoff for canary?

Ellen W.: +1 to canary with those gates. keep me looped on 24h telemetry. :eyes:
